top_stories.title: 【リリース】anthropic-sdk-python v2.5.0: v2.5.0
top_stories.body:
### Features

* **api:** add error details types and new error type values
* **api:** add ids filter to list workspaces
* **client:** add error classes for HTTP statuses and API error codes, and error_code, details and api_message on APIStatusError


### Bug Fixes

* **api:** capitalize CMEK in error details type names
* **api:** move some error details types to the resource they describe
* **bedrock:** raise a ValueError when model is "." or ".." instead of sending the request to a different path
* **bedrock:** raise a ValueError when model is empty instead of sending the request to `/model//

top_stories.title: 【リリース】anthropic-sdk-typescript google-cloud-sdk-v1.1.3: google-cloud-sdk-v1.1.3
top_stories.body:
### Bug Fixes

* **google-cloud:** percent-encode the project, location and workspace ID in the derived base URL, and throw an `AnthropicError` for a value of `.` or `..`

top_stories.title: 【リリース】anthropic-sdk-typescript vertex-sdk-v1.1.2: vertex-sdk-v1.1.2
top_stories.body:
### Bug Fixes

* **vertex:** percent-encode the project ID, region and model in the request path, so a `/` in the model can't move the request outside `/publishers/anthropic/models/`, and throw an `AnthropicError` for an empty `model` or a project ID or region of `.` or `..`

top_stories.title: 【リリース】anthropic-sdk-typescript sdk-v1.5.0: sdk-v1.5.0
top_stories.body:
### Features

* **api:** add error details types and new error type values
* **api:** add ids filter to list workspaces
* **client:** add error classes for HTTP statuses and API error codes, and apiMessage, errorCode and details on APIError


### Bug Fixes

* **api:** capitalize CMEK in error details type names
* **api:** move some error details types to the resource they describe
* **client:** reject path parameters like ";x", ".;x" and "..;x"
* **tools:** keep the memory tool from renaming or deleting the /memories directory


### Performance Improvements

* **streaming:** decode server-sent

top_stories.title: 【リリース】claude-code v2.1.318: v2.1.318
top_stories.body:
## What's changed

- Added a record of your answer when Claude Code asks to turn on the mods it writes in a session
- Added `assume_role` on `mantle` upstreams of the Claude apps gateway, for a role in another AWS account and for per-developer AWS cost attribution
- Added an `effort` option to a mod's `$.model.fork`, so a quick side job can run at `low` whatever effort the session uses; the result reports the effort sent
- Added the date a stored claude.ai sign-in ends to `claude auth status` (`loginExpiresAt`) and to `claude -p` JSON results (`credential_expires_at`)
- Added a one-line stderr

top_stories.title: 【リリース】claude-code v2.1.317: v2.1.317
top_stories.body:
## What's changed

- Added a warning to `/schedule` when a new cloud scheduled task gets connectors you did not ask for, with how to remove them
- Added a check that asks before a web or shell tool call sends your account email address to the network
- Added `onFailure: "block"` for Agent SDK hook callbacks, so a callback that fails blocks the action instead of letting it run
- Added a notice in Claude Desktop's Code tab when your organization's remote managed settings haven't loaded for the session, and another once they do
- Added a notice when auto mode's check has no answer for a subagent'

top_stories.title: 【リリース】anthropic-sdk-typescript sdk-v1.4.0: sdk-v1.4.0
top_stories.body:
### Features

* **api:** add GA methods for analytics, spend limits and RBAC
* **api:** add named beta types for unified metrics and RBAC delete responses
* **api:** add shared analytics order and increase request actor types
* **api:** add tool_use_limit_reached_error and compaction_limit_reached_error session error types
* **api:** add types for analytics group_by and spend limit period filters
* **api:** add user_profile_id to External Keys and Workspaces


### Bug Fixes

* **api:** make spend_limit nullable in the spend limit increase request approve response
* **api:** require always-sent
